name: Telleo
target_customers: Indian businesses that call leads and customers at volume: education, real estate, lending, healthcare and more

entry_price.notes: Monthly minimum billing at ₹3.99/min, telephony included; ₹19,999/year plan at ₹3.49/min with no minimum. Excludes 18% GST and DLT registration.

per_minute_from.notes: Annual plan; includes telephony, speech, LLM and voice for standard voices; billed in 30-second pulses

pricing.price_basis: per minute (monthly minimum or annual platform fee)

hindi_hinglish.evidence: Hindi, English and Hinglish in production, with gender-correct Hindi grammar and honorifics

indic_languages.evidence: Nine more Indian languages supported by the voice engines and set up on request; not yet proven in production

outbound_inbound.evidence: Outbound from workflows, campaigns or one click; inbound via an IVR on a Telleo number

live_transfer.evidence: Live transfer to per-agent handoff numbers after a bridge line

mid_call_actions.evidence: Sends an approved WhatsApp template mid-call when the caller accepts; meetings are booked after the call, no general tool calling

no_code_builder.evidence: No-code agent builder with AI-drafted scripts, templates and voice preview

api_webhooks.evidence: REST API at api.telleo.ai/v1 (single and batch calls, status, usage) and webhooks; docs at docs.telleo.ai

built_in_crm.evidence: Built-in CRM with lead statuses, owners, pipelines and round-robin assignment (Annual plan or Pro + CRM)

lead_source_connectors.evidence: Native Meta lead ads, Google lead forms and website-form webhook connectors that can trigger a call

whatsapp_followup.evidence: Approved WhatsApp templates sent after or during the call when the caller accepted

post_call_analysis.evidence: Disposition from your list, summary, 1-10 lead score and extracted answers on every connected call

call_qa.evidence: Green/amber/red health verdict per AI call with the reason (silence, missed answers, voicemail, failed transfer)

human_call_intelligence.evidence: Transcribes and scores reps' calls (click-to-call or uploaded) against a rubric, with coaching tips

telephony_included.evidence: Calls run on Telleo's lines in India; no SIMs, dialers or carrier contracts

languages_claimed: Hindi, English, Hinglish live; Tamil, Telugu, Marathi, Bengali, Gujarati, Kannada, Malayalam, Punjabi, Odia on request
india_compliance: Registers DLT with the customer (₹5,900/yr at actuals); calling hours enforced (default 9 am-9 pm)
notable_2025_2026: Relaunched as Telleo in October 2026, with Engine v2 and a public AI calling API.
